original.target_description: Experiment 1: paired predicted versus remembered Thanksgiving enjoyment, three-item composite

n.quote: Participants were 36 university students (15 males, 21 females) who completed two questionnaires
n.exclusions: 16 additional participants completed anticipation only and were absent from this paired analysis; footnote 1.

replication.target_description: Thanksgiving within-subject predicted/remembered enjoyment item (DV2); single item rather than original three-item composite

n.exclusions: General funneling removed two participants unable to mentally time travel and two unable to write about a scenario (p. 38). Main results explicitly described as pre-exclusion on p. 37; subsequent supplementary exclusions are not applied to these printed tests.

reported_success.quote: in the replication study we also found no support in the difference in Thanksgiving Day

notes: Extracted by neutral outcome description; supplied replication page locators interchange current emotion (DV1, p. 40) and predicted/remembered emotion (DV2, p. 41). No values converted. Replication main tables report pre-exclusion analyses, apart from general funneling. Replication enjoyment item selected because authors explicitly identify it in their abstract; a paired test of the original three-item DV2 composite was not established. Thus replication target_match is false. Supplied replication locator p. 40 is DV1.
